sloka: यथा च तव कैकेयी सुमित्रा च अविशेषतः ।तथैव देवी कौसल्या मम माता विशेषतः ॥२-५२-३५॥
transliteration: yathā ca tava kaikeyī sumitrā ca aviśeṣataḥ ।tathaiva devī kausalyā mama mātā viśeṣataḥ ॥2-52-35॥

translations.english: Just as you treat Kaikeyi and Sumitra in a special manner, so should you treat Devi Kausalya, my mother.
